title.zh: 在萨马省Salcedo市镇设立国立农业中学，名称为南萨马国立农业学校，并授权为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act to Establish a National Agricultural High School in the Municipality of Salcedo, Province of Samar, to be Known as the Southern Samar National Agricultural School, and to Authorize the Appropriation of Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act to Establish a National Agricultural High School in the Municipality of Salcedo, Province of Samar, to be Known as the Southern Samar National Agricultural School, and to Authorize the Appropriation of Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Trường Trung học Nông nghiệp Quốc gia tại Đô thị Salcedo, Tỉnh Samar với tên gọi Trường Nông nghiệp Southern Samar Quốc gia, và phân bổ kinh phí cho mục đích này
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาเกษตรกรรมแห่งชาติ ในเทศบาล Salcedo จังหวัด Samar ในชื่อ โรงเรียนเกษตรกรรม Southern Samar แห่งชาติ และจัดสรรเงินทุนสำหรับการนี้
title.id: Undang-Undang membentuk Sekolah Menengah Pertanian Nasional di Kotamadya Salcedo, Provinsi Samar dengan nama Sekolah Pertanian Southern Samar Nasional, dan mengalokasikan dana untuk itu
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan Sekolah Menengah Pertanian Kebangsaan di Perbandaran Salcedo, Wilayah Samar dengan nama Sekolah Pertanian Southern Samar Kebangsaan, dan memperuntukkan dana untuk itu

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1959/ra_2516_1959.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: There shall be established, under the direct supervision of the Director of Public Schools, a national agricultural school in the Municipality of Salcedo, Province of Samar, at a suitable site to be selected by said Director, to be known as the Southern Samar National Agricultural School.

Upon the recommendation of the Director of Public Schools, the President shall set aside and reserve such portion of the public lands located in the Municipality of Salcedo of said province, as may be necessary and convenient for the establishment of the said school and of its farm site.

The sum of two hundred thousand pesos is hereby authorized to be appropriated, out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for the establishment, operation and maintenance of the said school during the fiscal year ending June thirty, nineteen hundred sixty. Such sums as may be necessary for its operation and maintenance in subsequent years shall be included in the annual General Appropriation Acts.

This Act shall take effect upon the date the funds authorized herein to be appropriated shall have been provided for.
Approved: June 21, 1959.
